sources.citation: Rivierre, Jean-Claude & Alban Bensa. 2022. Du mot-à-mot au «faste mental». Enquêtes linguistiques et ethnolinguistiques en Nouvelle-Calédonie, Jean-Claude Rivierre (1938-2018). In: Uane nore nodei lanengoce / Penser les langues, Presses universitaires de la Nouvelle-Calédonie, pp.22-46. hal-05582019 (scan; scanned locally).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Generic only (p.40): the NC tone languages are contrasted with neighbouring Kanak languages 'qui.. marquent des accents en particulier sur la première syllabe (Moyse-Faurie, 2018)'; nothing language-specific for xârâgurè.

sources.citation: Moyse-Faurie, Claire. 2020 [HAL deposit 2023, 'à paraître']. Dictionnaire xârâgurè-français. Lacito-CNRS. 156 pp. (1. Présentation; 2. Conventions d'écriture et phonologie; 3. Esquisse grammaticale; lexique). hal-04299485.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on accent/stress placement. Phonology section (§2.1, PDF pp.6-9) covers syllable structure (C)V(C)V, 27 consonants, 17 short + 17 long vowels, vowel assimilation. §1 Présentation (PDF p.5) states the South-group languages incl. xârâgurè 'ne sont pas tonales'. The word 'accent' occurs only in the orthographic sense (diacritics, alphabetical order).

sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing; §4.1 gives only phoneme counts (17+17 vowels, 27 consonants) and orthography choices.

sources.citation: Moyse-Faurie, Claire. 2004. Catégorisation lexicale et problème de l'opposition verbo-nominale. Mémoire d'HDR, Université Paris 4 Sorbonne. 101 pp. tel-01408869.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: For the sister language XÂRÂCÙÙ only (pp.49-50, p.~80): noun + stative verb as a minimal sentence show 'une accentuation disjointe, chacun étant accentué sur l'initiale'; in verb series 'l'accent principal portant sur la première syllabe du premier verbe' (citing Rivierre 1978). No statement about xârâgurè accent.

sources.citation: Lynch, John (abstracter), 'Xârâcùù', in Lynch, Ross & Crowley 2002, The Oceanic Languages, Richmond: Curzon, pp.765-775 (based on Moyse-Faurie 1995).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Sister language Xârâcùù (xara1244) §1.3: 'Primary stress occurs on the initial syllable of any word with one, two or three syllables; with words of more than three syllables, stress occurs on the first two syllables.' Xaragure only named as the southern neighbour; no Xârâgurè statement.

sources.citation: Web pages: fr.wikipedia 'Xârâgurè'; Glottolog xara1243; ALK alk.nc/langues/xaragure; Sorosoro 'le xârâgurè'; Pangloss corpus Xârâgurè (21 transcribed recordings 1977-2010 by C. Moyse-Faurie); Persée search.
sources.note: None mention stress. Sorosoro: 'le xârâgurè s'apparente suffisamment à la langue xârâcùù pour lui consacrer le même système phonologique'. Pangloss audio+transcriptions exist (instrumental check possible).
